title: Black Fist Enforcers
html:
Black Fist Enforcers is a unique class action only available during the Confront the Elder Brain quest. It allows the party to summon  Slick Inatra and  Fishbait Arno to aid them in the final battle.

Description

Summon two elite assassin mercenaries from the Zhentarim's ranks.

Available only in combat.
Dismissed after combat until re-summoned.
Can't be summoned again if killed in combat.

How to learn

This spell is a variation of:
Gather Your Allies (class action)

Other ways to learn:

  • By completing the quest ⁠Aid the Underduke and siding with the Zhentarim against the Guild, gaining the Zhentarim as an ally during Gather Your Allies.

Notes

  • Slick Inatra and Fishbait Arno will be replaced by  Gravedigger Karcen and  Phase if they are killed during the battle for the Guildhall. If they have also died,  Zhent Elf,  Zhent Half-Elven and  Zhentmodeus will in turn be the summoned fallback characters.
